description: chain_walk calls cert.tbs_certificate.encode_to_slice into an 8192-byte stack buffer for every cert in the chain (line 719). For a 5-cert chain this is 5 encodes. Since the TBSCertificate is already in the input DER, there is no need to re-encode it: the caller could pass raw DER bytes and the implementation could use the original DER slice instead of re-encoding. This would eliminate the 8192-byte stack allocation, remove the encode_to_slice failure path, and improve throughput for chains validated in a loop. Document the re-encode cost or provide a validate_path_raw variant that takes pre-parsed DER slices.
title: encode_to_slice called per-cert in hot loop — avoidable allocation
